question: Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:**"Break the bank"**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **To spend too much money**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Break the bank"** means to spend an excessive amount of money, often beyond what one can afford. (बहुत अधिक पैसा खर्च करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Buying a luxury car would break the bank for most people.
 
 
• It does not literally refer to robbing a bank, but rather emphasizes spending to the point of financial strain.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To spend too much money**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To save money** (पैसे बचाना)
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to save money every month to buy a new house.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To rob a bank** (बैंक लूटना)
 
 
• **Example:** The movie depicts a group of criminals planning to rob a bank.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To invest wisely** (सही तरीके से निवेश करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He attended a financial seminar to learn how to invest wisely.
 
 

4b:Tc1c,

सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 3** अर्थात **बहुत अधिक पैसे खर्च करना**।
